items.name: theme
items.title: Naum Theme
items.description: Semantic light/dark tokens, radius and typography scales, surfaces and reduced-motion styles.

theme.font-sans:
var(
    --font-naum,
    "Plus Jakarta Sans",
    ui-sans-serif,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif
  )
theme.font-heading:
var(
    --font-naum,
    "Plus Jakarta Sans",
    ui-sans-serif,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif
  )

@utility naum-mesh-lime.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 85% 90%,
      oklch(0.84 0.16 95 / 85%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.58 0.12 135) 0%, oklch(0.75 0.15 100) 100%)

@utility naum-mesh-coral.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 85% 90%,
      oklch(0.82 0.12 55 / 85%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.66 0.19 25) 0%, oklch(0.77 0.14 48) 100%)

@utility naum-mesh-indigo.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 85% 85%,
      oklch(0.82 0.08 220 / 85%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.68 0.13 265) 0%, oklch(0.78 0.11 310) 100%)

@utility naum-mesh-amber.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 80% 95%,
      oklch(0.86 0.16 88 / 85%),
      transparent 58%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.75 0.1 65) 0%, oklch(0.78 0.16 78) 100%)

@utility naum-mesh-rose.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 80% 85%,
      oklch(0.72 0.2 350 / 85%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.76 0.14 10) 0%, oklch(0.68 0.2 345) 100%)

@utility naum-mesh-mint.background:
radial-gradient(
      circle at 85% 90%,
      oklch(0.84 0.12 145 / 85%),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.76 0.09 195) 0%, oklch(0.8 0.12 155) 100%)
